text:
marta: Postmortem follow-up for customer "Cerulean" dedicated deployment. Issue: intermittent tenant isolation breaches during failover due to stale NAT sessions + peering route re-advertise race. Need owners for remediation, CI tests, monitoring, and customer scheduling. @sanjay @lena @kevin please take items.

sanjay: I can own the route side. Action: add strict export filters for cerulean ASNs, introduce a route-stabilizer that delays re-announce for 30s after withdraw, and a de-dupe pass for prop scripts. Will draft PR and rollback notes. ETA: PR by Thu EOD.

lena: I'll run the on-prem audit with Cerulean ops to get NAT conntrack dumps and kernel versions. If vendor firmware is affected we need a temporary CT pruning tool. Need Cerulean maintenance window. ETA: audit started Mon.

kevin: Ops-tooling owner here. I'll create a small CT-pruner daemon we can deploy as a hotfix to customer edge (non-invasive, read-only by default) and a runbook. Will also add a forced connection-timer shrink option. Branch tonight; ETA: 4 days.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-5017 "Cerulean peering / CT drift investigation"  assignee: net-ops  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5017

marta: CI/QA: add a blueprints test that simulates asymmetric paths + conntrack churn and asserts no packet duplication/loopback. Also add nightly chaos test to run against dedicated staging. @kevin @sanjay coordinate.

sanjay: For monitoring I'll add a Grafana panel and alert. Suggest conditions: route_flap_rate > 2/5m OR conntrack_reassign_rate > 0.8%. Draft query: 
```
sum(rate(route_flap_total{customer="cerulean"}[5m]))
```
and
```
sum(rate(conntrack_reassign_total{customer="cerulean"}[5m])) / max(1, sum(rate(conntrack_total{customer="cerulean"}[5m])))
```
Will route slack notifications to #incidents and page on critical.

lena: Note: Cerulean runs vendor v3.0.0 on some edges; vendor confirmed similar NAT state bug exists but marked low priority. I'll ask for a vendor backstop and capture a compatibility shim option in INC-5017.

kevin: CT-pruner will have a dry-run mode to log candidate entries; we won't prune without explicit sign-off. Also creating an RFC for adding a conntrack-exporter to metrics so we can graph churn over time.

marta: Action summary for postmortem doc:
1) sanjay - route export filters + stabilizer + alerting (PR -> #PR-912) - ETA Thu EOD
2) lena - on-prem audit + vendor escalation (INC-5017) - ETA Mon next week
3) kevin - conntrack pruner tool + dry-run & runbook - ETA Fri next week
4) blueprints/CI chaos test - owner: kevin & tom (QA) - ETA 6 days
5) monitoring dashboard - owner: sanjay - ETA Wed

marta: Please update INC-5017 with milestones and drop PR/test links as they land. Short sync scheduled Tue 11:00 PT to confirm progress. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
